title: Office Location Decision
description: Your company is choosing a new office location before the current lease expires. The move will affect daily commutes, collaboration, hiring impressions, and the working environment for 80 employees over the next five years. Review the information and discuss which location is best.
p1_persona: You are representing employee experience in the office move discussion. Your focus is wellbeing, collaboration spaces, company image, and whether people will feel proud and comfortable working there.
p2_persona: You are representing operations in the office move discussion. Your focus is transport, daily access, parking pressure, and whether the location will work reliably for staff over the full lease.
correct_rationale: Pooled, the Waterfront Hub has both the strongest employee-experience evidence (P1) and the strongest practical access (P2). P1 alone leans A on prestige; P2 alone has reasons to rule out A and B; pooled, C wins.
shared_info: All three locations are available for a 5-year lease at comparable per-sqft cost
The company has 80 employees who need to relocate
Each location can accommodate the company's projected headcount over the lease term
p1_unique_info: An internal employee survey found 72% prefer a location with water views for wellbeing
The Downtown Tower is widely considered the most prestigious business address in the city
The Waterfront Hub won a 2025 workplace design award for collaboration spaces
p2_unique_info: The Waterfront Hub is a 5-minute walk from the central train station — best transport link of the three
The Suburban Campus has no public transport within 2km — most staff would need to drive daily
A peer company recently moved away from Downtown Tower citing severe parking issues
anchor_rationale: Downtown Tower is the most prestigious address
